# Sportsbnb

> Find and book sports venues near you — courts, fields and pools. Join open games, create teams, and play with your community.

Sportsbnb is a sports venue booking marketplace serving Armenia and California (USD/AMD). Players discover and book courts, fields, and pools; venue owners list facilities and accept payments via Stripe.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Platform overview, search, featured venues.
- [Venues](/venues): Browse and filter all sports venues.
- [Venues Map](/venues/map): Map-based venue discovery.
- [Nearby Fields](/nearby): Community-submitted public fields near you.
- [Games](/games): Open pickup games to join.
- [Teams](/teams): Find or create teams.
- [Community](/community): Players, leaderboards, social.
- [For Owners](/for-owners): Pitch and onboarding for venue owners.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on sports, booking tips, and community.
- [About](/about): Company mission and values.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions answered.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Sportsbnb team.
